conclusions.rationale: For each error probability choose a uniform-in-large-n stochastic bound M for sqrt(n)R_n/p_n. The deterministic scale times M eventually falls below any fixed epsilon, giving R_n->0 in probability.
conclusions.repair: No repair is needed. The O_p assertion supplies boundedness rather than convergence of the normalized factor.
